scope: 39 selected projects; all forks and portal excluded; AI Dashboard first; product and creative experiments at the end.
source_policy: Use only facts retained in the current selected map. Private project concepts rely on already-public atlas descriptions, not private source review.
ordering_policy: Sections organize responsibilities editorially. Sequence, adjacency, shared motion and arrow paths do not assert cross-repository runtime integration. EdgeRecord remains a separately labeled venture.

motion_policy.activity_target: Approximately three times the prior visible activity, achieved through concurrent project-relevant object streams rather than faster flashing.
motion_policy.meaning: All motion is illustrative and conceptual; labels for prototype, fixture, private-description concept and human decisions remain visible.
motion_policy.accessibility: Retain explicit play/pause and reduced-motion alternatives.

sections.label: Factory core
sections.rationale: Begin with the published local command center and local supervisor roles; source descriptions do not establish a universal deployed pipeline.

sections.label: Workflow and sessions
sections.rationale: Follow the editorial story from selected intent and evidence to bounded work, persistent sessions and records; adjacency is not a runtime integration claim.

sections.label: Verification and learning
sections.rationale: Present independent review, bounded failure models and reusable lessons after the work-session tools.

sections.label: Testing fixtures
sections.rationale: Keep documented synthetic data and protocol fixtures with supporting test/rehearsal tools; none is customer evidence.

sections.label: Local compute and transport
sections.rationale: Group observation, advisory capacity, inference queues, numerical experiments and transport by local-system responsibility. BumperFort precedes LineasFlows because its public description names the numerical state source.

sections.label: EdgeRecord — separate venture
sections.rationale: Keep the separately positioned EdgeRecord venture in its own labeled section. Only already-public atlas roles are used; do not imply it is a subsidiary, a deployed factory dependency or part of a new business claim.

sections.label: Publishing and orientation
sections.rationale: Place the public profile and portfolio after the project evidence they organize; they are communication surfaces, not execution engines.

sections.label: Product and creative experiments
sections.rationale: Finish with prototype products, fictional concept demonstrations and creative software. These are independent examples, not steps in the factory workflow.
